How Brigade Meadows manages zero waste and recycles 6 lakh litres of water daily. See how this Bengaluru society handles trash.
This episode of Solved in India visits Brigade Meadows, a community of 7000 residents that manages 800 kgs of daily waste without sending anything to a landfill. We look at the specific rules, like fines for using plastic bags, that allow this massive residential complex to operate sustainably. If you are interested in urban sustainability or how large societies can implement effective waste management, this breakdown shows the practical steps taken on the ground.
